title: a Cargo.toml with a multi-line array whose element lines open with `[` is refused as holding no version
body:
**Measured** at 4c6fe838 by the chain's critic (`cr0260chain-0528/extra.out`). `[package]` then `keywords = [` with a following line `  [1, 2],`: version_line (0263) reads `[1, 2],` as a table header, leaves [package], and reads no version, so set refuses the file as "holds no version devbin reads".

**Cause.** The awk takes any line opening with `[` (after whitespace) as a table header, inside an array as well.

**Fix.** Track array depth in version_line's cargo branch (an open `[` after `=` with no closing `]` on the line opens it, and a line closing it ends it), and read headers only at depth zero. This errs toward refusal today, so no file is written wrongly.

**Done when.**
1. Such a Cargo.toml reads its [package] version, and set rewrites that line alone.
2. The existing cargo arms stay green under BSD awk and mawk.


Drafted by dc (2026-10-28), measured and filed by vc; low, and not in 0.1.16.

## Resolution

- A Cargo.toml's table headers are read only outside a multi-line array. version_line's cargo program counts each value's brackets outside its strings and comment, and reads a line opening with `[` as a header only at depth zero.
- Landed on main at 2870b62d, with 0280.
- Arms in tests/unit/version.bats:
  - "a Cargo.toml whose multi-line array has element lines opening with [ reads its [package] version, and set rewrites that line alone (0281)", whose array holds a `[1, 2]` element and a `"[x]"` string;
  - 0263's cargo arms, a dependency table's version and [workspace.package], still hold.
- The program was driven by hand under BSD awk and mawk.
- Desk evidence: hv's full run on rhadamanth, sealed at tmp/test/20261029-1314.bats.out and .bats.errors: 2824 ok and 2 not ok, neither of them this issue's.
